Show less Read more Like 6 Dislike Reply @patriciaferrini-xt1ry 6 months ago (edited) RIP Robert Redford you have done a great legacy. Thank you very much for your personnality. Show less Read more Like 7 Dislike Reply @CaptainKidd-p5g 6 months ago R.I.P Robert Redford Heartfelt thoughts to your family friends and fans during this time. Thank you for the many many years of entertainment and art 🇺🇸 Show less Read more Like 5 Dislike Reply @2023AHD 6 months ago There are men who inspire trust and bring peace through their actions, their work, their mission. Your face, Mr. Charles Robert Redford, has been on the wall of my office in France for many years and remains etched in my memory, like that unforgettable image with Meryl Streep in Out of Africa. From Butch Cassidy to The Sting, you shaped my imagination. Through the Sundance Institute and your commitment to the planet, you left an indelible mark on history. My heartfelt thoughts go to the Redford family and to all your loved ones. Hakeem Show less Read more Like 7 Dislike Reply @denisej.7623 4 months ago Thank you for sharing such a beautiful tribute to such a beautiful man! If his passing is still still hard for me, can’t imaging how hard this is for his family and his Sundance family! Will never forget the words you spoke about the “glory of art”: how it “can not only survive change, but lead it”! May your legacy live on for generations to come! RIP Mr. Redford. Show less Read more Like 2 Dislike Reply @quarkonium1 6 months ago I have had the privilege of attending the Sundance Film Festival for 16 years, until the birth of our daughter. One cannot attend without knowing deep in the bones the importance, value, and rightness of diversity in all its forms. What better way to show this than through film? Watching these films has changed my life. I will be always grateful to Robert Redford for championing this legacy and to the independent filmmakers sharing their points of view with us all. Each point of view is like a gemstone. I cannot wait to bring our daughter to share in this beautiful jewel box. Show less Read more Like 2 Dislike Reply @Vincentanton2032 6 months ago Thank you Robert Redford for your inspiring words, for sundance, for all the art and emotion in front of a camera and behind. Through my entire life i often wondered, especially in certain situations, what would Robert Redford do at this point? You were the most authentic person i never met. Sadly. But you were there, out there in the world, fighting for your values. You are my true hero. You will always be. You will be missed, always, but you will be remembered, always. We meet again, on the other side... Bob’s vision of a space and a platform for independent voices launched a movement that, over four decades later, has inspired generations of artists and redefined cinema in the U.S. and around the world. Beyond his enormous contributions to culture at large, we will miss his generosity, clarity of purpose, curiosity, rebellious spirit, and his love for the creative process. We are humbled to be among the stewards of his remarkable legacy, which will continue to guide the Institute in perpetuity.
